name: TVMaze
tagline: Free TV show, episode, and cast lookup API with schedules and search.
description: TVMaze provides a free public API for television show data: search and lookup by name or ID, episode lists and air dates, cast and crew, images, and country/network schedules. No API key is required for the public endpoints; optional paid/higher-limit access may exist for heavy use. Responses are JSON. Widely used for media apps, calendars, and show metadata enrichment.

auth.details: Public API requires no authentication or API key for standard endpoints. Fair-use rate limiting applies; contact TVMaze for commercial/high-volume use.

pricing.free_tier_limits: Free for non-commercial use with fair-use rate limits; commercial use requires permission/arrangement.

rate_limits: not published precisely; fair use; roughly ~20 requests per 10 seconds commonly cited (verify current docs).
use_cases: get episode list and air dates for a show
lookup show details by TVMaze ID
get today's TV schedule for a country
fetch cast and crew for a series
resolve show metadata for media libraries
